target.topic_name: Collapse of Thailand State Audit Office building
target.source_page: Collapse of Thailand State Audit Office building

card.fact_statement: China Railways Number 10 was part of the joint venture that contracted the Thailand State Audit Office building.
card.source_span: the contractors were the joint venture between Italian-Thai Development and China Railways Number 10 (Thailand) Co., Ltd.

target_qa_variants.question: Ni kampuni gani yenye ushirika wa kigeni iliyokuwa sehemu ya ubia uliochukua kandarasi ya jengo la Ofisi ya Ukaguzi wa Serikali ya Thailand kabla ya kuporomoka kwake?
target_qa_variants.source_span: the contractors were the joint venture between Italian-Thai Development and China Railways Number 10 (Thailand) Co., Ltd.
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'foreign-affiliated company' to 'kampuni yenye ushirika wa kigeni' and 'joint venture' to 'ubia'. Company names are kept in their standard international forms.

backtranslation_en.question: Which foreign-affiliated company was part of the joint venture that took the contract for the State Audit Office of Thailand building before its collapse?

backtranslation_consistency.reason: The Swahili translation accurately preserves the entity, relation, and expected answer of the source question without adding new constraints.
